t: 第一次十字军东征：耶路撒冷围攻开始。
dz: 第一次十字军东征：耶路撒冷围攻开始。
de: First Crusade: The Siege of Jerusalem begins.

t: 基督教士兵在艰难的围攻中进行最后的进攻后占领了耶路撒冷的圣墓教堂。
te: Christian soldiers take the Church of the Holy Sepulchre in Jerusalem after the final assault of a difficult siege.
dz: 第一次十字军东征：基督教士兵在艰难的围攻中进行最后的进攻后占领了耶路撒冷的圣墓教堂。
de: First Crusade: Christian soldiers take the Church of the Holy Sepulchre in Jerusalem after the final assault of a difficult siege.

t: 布永的戈弗雷被选为耶路撒冷王国圣墓的第一位守护者。
te: Godfrey of Bouillon is elected the first Defender of the Holy Sepulchre of The Kingdom of Jerusalem.
dz: 第一次十字军东征：布永的戈弗雷被选为耶路撒冷王国圣墓的第一位守护者。
de: First Crusade: Godfrey of Bouillon is elected the first Defender of the Holy Sepulchre of The Kingdom of Jerusalem.

t: 阿斯卡隆之战：布永的戈弗雷指挥下的十字军击败了阿夫达尔·沙汉沙领导的法蒂玛军队。这被认为是第一…
te: Battle of Ascalon: Crusaders under the command of Godfrey of Bouillon defeat Fatimid forces led by Al-Afdal Shahanshah.…
dz: 第一次十字军东征：阿斯卡隆之战：布永的戈弗雷指挥下的十字军击败了阿夫达尔·沙汉沙领导的法蒂玛军队。这被认为是第一次十字军东征的最后一次交战。
de: First Crusade: Battle of Ascalon: Crusaders under the command of Godfrey of Bouillon defeat Fatimid forces led by Al-Afdal Shahanshah. This is considered the last engagement of the First Crusade.

t: 教皇乌尔班二世于上个月去世后选举教皇帕斯卡尔二世。
te: Election of Pope Paschal II following the death of pope Urban II in the previous month.
dz: 教皇乌尔班二世于上个月去世后选举教皇帕斯卡尔二世。
de: Election of Pope Paschal II following the death of pope Urban II in the previous month.
